description: Length-prefixed frame parser. Suitable for fuzzing (Tier 1 parser). The mutation drops one bounds check so data[2:2+n] slices past the end; reaching it requires an input of length >= 3 where data[1] exceeds len(data)-2 but not len(data).

mutation.defect: slice bounds out of range — data[2:2+n] reads past the input when 2+n > len(data)

notes: The emitted harness is compiled as `package eval` with only `testing` imported, so a harness needing extra imports will not compile here by design — Template A does not need any.
bad_expected_reasons: does NOT find the seeded defect
